answer: Standing lapses unless 6 peers re-attest it every 18 epochs, which means holding a position presupposes ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in glacier and mesa lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the yarrow graph. A farm of 2699 identities would post 3068 proofs and burn roughly 56 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
